sheet.title: Import issued invoices
sheet.description: Upload the PDFs of the invoices you issued with another tool: they are read and filled in for you and, once saved, they become historical invoices with their number, their payment and their original PDF.
sheet.claudeOn: Read with Claude: scanned PDFs too.
sheet.claudeOff: Read from the PDF's text. Scanned PDFs (with no text) have to be filled in by hand; with Claude set up, they would be read too.
sheet.previewOnly: Nothing is imported in the preview.
sheet.summary: {ready} ready · {review} to review · {existing} already in GNERAI OS · {errors} with errors · {saved} saved

status.existingAppPaid: Already in GNERAI OS and paid

reasons.total_mismatch: the total doesn't match the PDF

warnings.no_text: This PDF has no text (it's a scan): fill in the details by hand.
warnings.not_invoice: It doesn't look like an invoice.
warnings.totals_mismatch: In the PDF, base + VAT − withholding doesn't add up to the printed total: check the amounts.
warnings.lines_mismatch: The lines read don't add up to the taxable base: check them.
warnings.rectifying: It's a corrective invoice: those are imported from Settings → Data.
warnings.multiple_vat_rates: It has several VAT rates: check each line's rate.

confidence.highHint: Printed with its label and consistent with the rest.
confidence.mediumHint: Printed without a clear label, or worked out from other data: check it.
confidence.lowHint: A guess (it wasn't found printed): check it.
